verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a 'ROS-Base' install with communication libraries and command-line tools but no GUI tools. Its scriptable `ros2` CLI can publish and echo topics, record and play bags, and run `ros2 doctor`, and a launch system coordinates multiple nodes, so the core of headless, scripted automation is clearly supported. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g., running tests or launch files in CI pipelines or containers), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
